principal.titulo: Parked in Salvador? Activate your Zona Azul with ZAS.
principal.subtitulo: Check the street sign, choose the matching time, and confirm parking for your vehicle's license plate.

oQueE.titulo: ZAS: the official Zona Azul app for Salvador
paragrafos: Since October 2018, Salvador's Zona Azul has been digital: Transalvador replaced paper booklets with the Cartela Azul Digital. With ZAS, you use that balance straight from your phone.

voceEstacionou.titulo: You parked — here is what to do now
passos: Check the sign for the space.
Select the time shown at the spot.

acao.rotulo: See the full step by step

voceEstacionou.apoio: The parking rule can change from one place to another. Before you activate, check the sign and choose the matching duration in ZAS.

tarifas.introducao: Choose the period shown on the sign.

fiscalizacao.texto: Enforcement looks up the vehicle's license plate in the system. Always check that parking was confirmed for the right plate, and keep an eye on the end time.

institucional.titulo: ZAS is an accredited app for Salvador's digital Zona Azul
institucional.texto: The app lets you buy and activate rotating parking credit, following the rules set for the city and shown on the local signs.

operacao.titulo: The people who make ZAS happen
operacao.destaque: Salvador, looked after by people who call the city home.

pontos.texto: Sindguarda is the union of the attendants who work in the city's Zona Azul.
With ZAS, the parking fee stays in Salvador and supports these workers and their families.
Men, women, and people with specific needs work side by side to do their best for Salvador.
